y3r24nmq.baseName: COSTWAY 2ft Fibre Optic Christmas Tree with 60 PVC Tips - Green
y3r24nmq.variantName: COSTWAY 2ft Fibre Optic Christmas Tree with 60 PVC Tips - Green
y3r24nmq.sourceDescription: Decorations come in all sizes, and this 60cm fibre optic Christmas tree is great for decorating the smaller rooms in your home or for a table decoration for the big day! Pre-lit, hassle free, this tree. When you decorate your room for the coming Christmas, do not forget those corners! The tabletop Christmas tree is suitable for dining tables, coffee tables, cashier desks, etc. If you are looking for a mini tabletop Christmas tree like this, do not hesitate to place an order! Full-bodied Christmas Tree: Although it is only a 60 cm high, mini table tree, it consists of 60 finely crafted branch tips. All the branch tips form a dense and full artificial Christmas tree, which will bring a keen sense of nature and vitality to your home. From a distance, it's even hard for you to tell the difference between the tree and a real one. Colour Changing Fibre Optics: This pre-lit Christmas tree is trimmed with multiple fibre optics, providing you with a special user experience. These fibre optics will change colour slowly once you plug the tree in. The soft lights create a festive atmosphere. Premium PVC Materials: This artificial Christmas tree not only looks good but is also of excellent quality. The branch tips are made from 100% PVC, which is odourless, non-toxic, flame retardant and recyclable. This quality Christmas tree is suitable for any room in your home. Compact Size: Designed for tabletops, or windowsills etc., where it can be displayed in all its glory, this compact Christmas tree still provides the festive atmosphere expected of a Christmas tree! Suitable for domestic and commercial use. Stable Plastic Base: The Christmas tree is supported by a wide plastic base, ensuring it is straight and stable for the festive period. Suitable to be decorated with small Christmas decorations, the fibre optic tree has a power cord of 191cm ensuring that it can reach a power socket wherever you place it. Specifications: Colour: Green Material: New PVC, metal, plastic Overall dimension: 34 cm x 60 cm (D x H) Net weight: 5 kg Number of tips: 60 Power Cord length: 191 cm Box Qty:1(May vary by batch) Is Assembly Required: Yes Package includes： 1 x Fibre optic Christmas tree Retain instructions for future reference.always place the product on a flat, steady and stable surface.keep all small parts and packaging materials for this product away from babies and children as they potentially pose a serious choking hazard. FDS CORPORATION LIMITED Unit 4, Blackacre Road, Great Blakenham, Ipswich, United Kingdom, IP6 0FL

s63p05hh.baseName: Christmas Tree World 50m Extra Thick Fire Retardant Silver Tinsel
s63p05hh.variantName: Christmas Tree World 50m Extra Thick Fire Retardant Silver Tinsel
s63p05hh.sourceDescription: Bring plenty of traditional Christmas sparkle to your display with our 50m Extra Thick Fire Retardant Silver Tinsel. Combining a full 8-ply construction with an impressive 12cm thickness, it provides substantially more volume and visual impact than standard tinsel, making it particularly effective for larger Christmas trees and festive displays. The brilliant metallic silver finish catches and reflects the surrounding light beautifully, creating a bright, shimmering appearance. Its mixture of reflective strands gives the tinsel a rich, full look, while the classic silver colouring works particularly well against green Christmas foliage and complements virtually any festive colour scheme. Supplied in a generous continuous 50m length, you can use the tinsel as one long run or simply cut it into the individual lengths required for your display. This makes it particularly useful for larger decorating projects and allows you to decorate multiple areas without having to join together lots of shorter retail-sized lengths. The tinsel is also fire retardant, making it a practical choice for commercial festive displays as well as decorating around the home. Whether you're wrapping a large Christmas tree, decorating railings and displays or creating a substantial commercial installation, this extra thick silver tinsel provides plenty of length, coverage and eye-catching festive sparkle. Product Features • 50m extra thick silver tinsel • Full 8-ply construction • Generous 12cm thickness • Brilliant metallic silver finish • Highly reflective for maximum festive sparkle • Supplied in one continuous 50m length • Easily cut to your required lengths • Fire retardant • Ideal for large Christmas trees and displays • Perfect for domestic and commercial decorating Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester WN5 8DB

sz5fkbc9.baseName: Neo 240cm Inflatable Halloween LED Lights Pumpkin Indoor Outdoor Archway
sz5fkbc9.variantName: Neo 240cm Inflatable Halloween LED Lights Pumpkin Indoor Outdoor Archway
sz5fkbc9.sourceDescription: Create an impressive Halloween entrance with this 2.4m Inflatable Halloween Arch, featuring a colourful combination of pumpkins, ghosts, skulls and bats for a fun yet spooky seasonal display. Measuring approximately 230 × 70 × 240cm when inflated, this large freestanding archway makes an eye-catching addition to gardens, pathways, entrances, Halloween parties and haunted house displays. The inflatable features 12 warm white internal LEDs, illuminating the characters from within to create a striking display after dark. A DC 12V / 1.2A built-in air blower provides quick inflation, while the 3m power lead, ground stakes, tethers and 500ml water bags provide everything needed for convenient setup and added stability. Made from durable 210T polyester, the inflatable can be deflated and folded compactly for convenient storage between celebrations. Large 2.4M Halloween arch: Measuring approximately 230 × 70 × 240cm inflated, this impressive Halloween inflatable creates a fun entrance for gardens, pathways, parties, trick-or-treat events and haunted house displays. 12 Warm Led Lights: Features 12 built-in warm white LEDs that illuminate the inflatable characters from within, creating an eye-catching Halloween display after dark. Pumpkin, ghost, bat and Skull design: Packed with classic Halloween characters and colourful detailing, making the archway a playful yet spooky centrepiece for your seasonal decorations. Built in blower: Equipped with a DC 12V / 1.2A air blower for quick and convenient inflation, along with a 1.5A power cable and 3m lead cable for easy positioning. Secure anchor set included: Supplied with 5 plastic ground stakes, 2 × 1.5m white tethers and 2 × 500ml water weight bags to provide additional stability when setting up the inflatable. Durable 210T polyester: Constructed from durable 210T polyester fabric and designed as a freestanding inflatable decoration suitable for seasonal outdoor displays. Easy to deflate and store: Once Halloween is over, simply deflate the archway and fold it down into a compact size for convenient storage until your next celebration. This product is intended for decorative purposes only and is not a toy. Keep away from young children and pets. Adult assembly and supervision are recommended. Use only with the supplied compatible blower and power components. Keep the power cable, plug and electrical connections protected from water and moisture, and do not operate if any electrical component or cable is damaged. Keep away from naked flames, heaters and other heat or ignition sources. Secure the inflatable using the supplied stakes, tethers and weight bags before use. Do not use outdoors in strong winds, storms or severe weather conditions. Do not climb, sit, stand or hang on the inflatable or anchoring components. Ensure entrances, pathways and emergency exits remain unobstructed. Deflate and disconnect from the power supply before moving, cleaning or storing. Inspect before each use and discontinue use if damaged. Neo Direct Ltd. Butterley Street, Leeds, LS10 1AW
